county.name: Amos Kimwomi Nyaribo
county.since: Dec 2020 (took over after Governor Nyagarama died); elected Aug 2022
county.note: In November 2025 the County Assembly voted to impeach Governor Nyaribo (23 MCAs voted; 19 were physically present). On 3 December 2025 the Senate upheld a preliminary objection that the Assembly had not met the two-thirds threshold. The impeachment was terminated and Nyaribo remains in office. The charges were never tested on their merits.

county.name: James Gesami
county.since: Aug 2021 (approved by the Assembly); elected Aug 2022

county.name: Thaddeus Nyabaro Momanyi
county.note: Disputed. The Bomet High Court (Justice Ngarngar) affirmed Okero's impeachment was valid and recognised Nyabaro as the legitimate Speaker, with only gazettement outstanding. Okero appealed; no published outcome found as of Nov 2026. In March 2026 The Standard reported a Labour Court finding that Okero's removal was unlawful. Nyabaro chairs every 2025–2026 sitting in the Hansard and expelled 10 MCAs in mid-2025.

nyansiongo.name: Jackson Mogusu Mochumbe
nyansiongo.note: Won the by-election on 27 Nov 2025 after the 2022 result was overturned on petition. Gazetted 1 Dec 2025.

rigoma.name: Emmanuel Nyambega Gisesa
rigoma.note: Expelled Jul 2025 for absenteeism; reinstated by interim High Court order (Judge Okwany). Full hearing was set for 30 Jul 2025; no published outcome found as of Nov 2026.

nyamaiya.name: Christopher Moturi Osiemo
nyamaiya.note: Elected on 27 Nov 2025 after the death of MCA Elijah Osiemo Thomas in 2024. Gazetted 1 Dec 2025.

bokeira.name: Joel Ombongi Nyang'au
bokeira.note: Expelled Jul 2025 for absenteeism; reinstated by interim High Court order (Judge Okwany). Full hearing was set for 30 Jul 2025; no published outcome found as of Nov 2026.

ekerenyo.name: Jeremiah Njenga Ongaro
ekerenyo.note: Elected on 27 Nov 2025 after MCA Thaddeus Nyabaro became Speaker. Gazetted 1 Dec 2025.
